invariants: One consistent left navigation across every screen: Dictate, Whisper-Ahead, Cleanup, Relay, Voiceprint, Conductor, Privacy, Dictionary, Analytics, Setup.
Card radius stays 8px; components are compact cards, tables, segmented controls, toggles, icon buttons, status badges, small charts, and native OS permission panels.
Prediction suggestions render blue in every theme; an accepted prediction pulses amber-gold for roughly 0.5s then settles to normal text.
Destructive Conductor actions always require an explicit confirm gate.
Never imply cloud sync for core features; Harbor is an optional hosted service only, and every Harbor service has a self-hostable path.
All controls keyboard-reachable, readable at high OS scaling, with no text overlap at narrow desktop widths.
Default, light, and dark modes exist for every OS; only the single free-tier accent differs by OS lane; premium theme expansion may add colors later without changing layout.

gates.title: Latency + footprint budgets met in Raw mode (release->inject <=700ms GPU / <=1200ms CPU; idle RAM <=250MB)
gates.notes: PENDING with stronger real evidence. On the Apple M5 Pro, true Metal warm inference passed repeatedly at 55-67 ms (<=700 ms) and explicit CPU at 208 ms (<=1200 ms). On Debian 12 ARM64, a requested uncompiled GPU lane correctly reported LocalCpu and passed at 999 ms (<=1200 ms) with an exact transcript. Windows 11 ARM64 then passed the same real clip at 1071 ms (<=1200 ms) after 513 ms warmup, truthfully reporting LocalCpu after a GPU request. The Windows ARM64 build required official clang-cl/Ninja components, C++ exceptions, and target-generated libclang bindings because current whisper.cpp rejects MSVC on ARM and the bundled bindings are not target-correct. The runtime preloads the first viable adapter before first dictation and reports the lane that actually ran. The canonical launcher ships Metal on macOS and CPU Whisper on Windows/Linux; release/proof builds default GGML_NATIVE=OFF so they do not inherit the build host's instruction set, and a native-config stamp invalidates the matching Cargo profile when those untracked upstream settings change. A clean portable macOS rebuild proved GGML_NATIVE=OFF plus Metal and passed the real clip at 59 ms. Reviewed architecture-specific builds can override the default. PR CI tests each shipped feature. No-model footprint measured 30 MB for the main process but about 86 MB for the full Kaydence+WebKit process group, so the full group is about 6 MB over the <80 MB no-model target. Still required: full release-to-inject timing, ASR-resident RAM and idle CPU, reference-machine p50/p95, resolution of the no-model process-group boundary/overage, and release automation for the Windows ARM64 Clang contract.
